stories.headline: After nearly 30 years, a man is on trial in the fatal shooting of Tupac Shakur. Here's what to know - AP News
stories.summary: The trial of Duane “Keffe D” Davis for the murder of Tupac Shakur begins Monday in Las Vegas. Davis, 62, is accused of orchestrating the 1996 shooting of the iconic rapper. Prosecutors allege Davis p…
stories.why: This trial finally closes a 30-year-old cultural wound for the generation that grew up on '90s hip-hop; it's about whether justice can still arrive when you thought the case was dead, and what that says about accountability in America.

stories.headline: Meghan Markle, Prince Harry box-office flop shows 'infamy' doesn't equal success: expert - Fox News
stories.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's Girl Scouts documentary opened in 446 theaters, but royal experts question whether Sussex star power sells tickets.
stories.why: Royal obsession doesn't translate to actual cultural relevance anymore—this is the moment the Harry & Meghan celebrity currency definitively deflated, signaling that manufactured controversy can't compete with actual compelling content.

stories.headline: X-Men: Christopher Abbott and Sadie Sink in new Marvel movie - BBC
stories.summary: Heartstopper's Kit Connor and Christopher Abbot are also joining the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
stories.why: Marvel's pivot toward casting younger, TV-famous talent over established movie stars shows the MCU is betting on Gen Z nostalgia (Heartstopper) rather than proven box office, betting your childhood streaming favorites will carry $200M franchises.

stories.headline: D23 live updates: Exclusive trailers shown for new movies, shows - ABC7 Los Angeles
stories.summary: From newly announced movies to rides coming to a Disney park near you soon, we have all the live updates from D23: The Ultimate Disney Fan Event.
stories.why: D23 announcements matter because Disney is telegraphing where blockbuster IP is headed next—the films and shows you'll be culturally obligated to watch or get left out of group conversations for the next three years.

stories.headline: Da'Vine Joy Randolph Sues Landlord Over Alleged $17K a Month Rental From Hell - TMZ
stories.summary: Da’Vine Joy Randolph is dragging her landlord to court … claiming she rented a luxury home for $17K a month … only to have to deal with pests and plumbing issues ... TMZ has learned.
stories.why: A rising Oscar winner (after The Holdovers breakout) having to sue over a trashed $17K/month rental exposes how even 'made it' status doesn't protect you from predatory landlords, a relatable financial horror regardless of fame.

stories.headline: D23 2026: Watch the 'VisionQuest' Trailer - Marvel.com
stories.summary: Paul Bettany returns as Vision in the new Marvel Television series, premiering October 14 on Disney+.
stories.why: Vision getting his own series signals Marvel's abandoning the team-up formula for solo deep dives; this is the moment the MCU stops treating secondary characters as supporting players and starts betting they can carry prestige TV.

stories.headline: D23 2026: Ryan Gosling is Kade Auberon in Star Wars: Starfighter - StarWars.com
stories.summary: The star took the stage with Director Shawn Levy to tease the next Star Wars feature film arriving Memorial Day 2027.
stories.why: Ryan Gosling taking a Star Wars lead isn't just casting—it's Disney signaling they're willing to spend blockbuster capital on A-listers again after the sequel trilogy fatigue, betting his indie credibility can restore the franchise's cool factor.

stories.headline: D23 2026: Star Wars: Ahsoka Season 2 Teaser Trailer and Release Date Revealed - StarWars.com
stories.summary: Creator Dave Filoni and stars Rosario Dawson, Hayden Christensen, and Eman Esfandi tease the next chapter for Ahsoka Tano.
stories.why: Hayden Christensen returning for Ahsoka Season 2 confirms the prequels are officially rehabilitated in canon, validating the re-evaluation you've probably done of those films and signaling nostalgia, not quality, drives Star Wars forward now.
